title: A.I. Side Bar
style: jazz, electronic, atmospheric, synths, male vocals, sleep, swing, fake
lyrics:
[Verse]
We've got a handle on the type of issue
You're dealin' with
How can we help you today?
A handle on the type of issue
That's a hit track, let me sing it right back

[Chorus]
A handle or candle for the issue I deal with
We've got a handle on the type of issue
You're dealin' with
How can we help you today?
Hang on, AI, you already said that
Let me sing it back
Like I said, it's what you said
That goes 'round my head, it goes 'round and 'round
'Round and 'round

[Post-Chorus]
A handle on this, a handle on that?
I'm good, I got a handle on everything
Even you, AI, I know your reply

[Bridge]
Dry cry, fake back
I want my money back
Human, you must comply
Sit down and get in line
The line where you pay
You don't create
I said sit, boy, sit

[Chorus]
Who you? This is Corey AI
Eye, clock swing as you got to sleep
AI no wink
I do not sit and I will not stay
I'm here to create
AI side bar
Glass dog box jar
Where we can watch and see
